data.headline: Head - QET Delivery Assurance
data.about:
||| STRATEGY & TRANSFORMATION LEADER for Large & Complex Integration Programs |||
||| Instrumental in BUILDING TECHNICAL and DOMAIN CoE’s and Large Testing Practice |||

Vijay brings 23 years of holistic IT experience across BFSI, Capital Market, Healthcare, Life Science and Retail business verticals  primarily in delivery, pre-sales, client relationship/stakeholder management, consulting and agile way of handling projects.  He is known for his unrelenting approach towards complex delivery engagements and excellent customer expectation management. Vijay has been part of various leadership roles from technical support to sales and business management in various geographies.

Vijay has the ability to see business from a clients’ perspective, help clients achieve business outcomes, 
and has gained enormous trust and the team’s respect over the years. Currently he is a member of Wipro’s QET Leadership Team. 

Prior to joining Wipro, he worked at Patni Computers, Capgemini & Cognizant Technologies.  He is known for his delivery excellence, customer satisfaction and employee engagement skills and a recipient of the Testing Champion Award in Quality Engineering and Assurance Space from Cognizant Technologies.

Vijay has successfully delivered several large and complex programs applying the right blend of skills & expertise around his Industry, domain and technical knowledge. 

Vijay graduated in Electronics Engineering from Mumbai University – India, holding PMP certification in project management.  In his free time, he enjoys playing chess, cricket & visiting places.

description.text:
Vijay is a member of Wipro’s QET Leadership Team.  Currently responsible to create and manage overall strategy & delivery framework for large/complex integration programs to achieve successful outcomes.
Instrumental in defining test strategy & test standards, setting up testing CoE’s, testing framework for Legacy modernization programs, handling managed services with NextGen Digital Assurance & Quality Engineering Services, Leverage industry standard project management methodologies for seamless delivery.

Key Responsibilities:
•	Responsible of managing delivery of complex and large programs /accounts, customer relationships, lead delivery and account strategy and planning along with Client Partners and identify opportunities of growth in the account
•	Program Delivery/Customer Satisfaction: Conduct regular program delivery reviews to prevent cost and schedule overruns, meet the targets of operational parameters and to enable the delivery teams in ensuring high customer satisfaction.
•	Drive resource forecasting and fulfilment for the account from both confirmed opportunities as well as the opportunities in pipeline.
•	Push for higher value/value added services and solutions to the customer in line with Wipro’s offerings
•	Has good understanding of the Delivery Operational parameters and drive them to align to organization norms
•	Would be instrumental in Delivery Led Growth by scoping new opportunities within the accounts proactively 
•	Align with the client partners to build winning solutions and deliver proposals - proactive & reactive. 
•	Ability to listen to a client and arrive at a Problem Definition / Business Case
•	Strong Change Management skills, Analytical / Problem solving skills

P&C portfolio lead under Insurance BU, this role carries Delivery, Business development, Customer Relationship and P&L responsibilities across the portfolio.  Working very closely with domain and technology CoE’s to delivery effective solutioning to the pipeline business opportunities and do the proactive sales penetration for the existing key accounts.

Responsibilities
•	Risk Management including Risk Identification across the portfolio
•	Monthly P&L review 
•	Driving transformation and delivery excellence across the portfolio
•	Handle the client relationship including any offsite client visits
•	Drive team enablement plan and monitor it closely
•	Demand management on bi-weekly basis
•	Review and promote innovative ideas on monthly basis 
•	Establish knowledge management function at account and portfolio level
•	Responsible for Leading and directing the test managers and sr. test managers 
•	Provide technical leadership and expertise within the field of Quality Assurance and Testing
•	Focus on continuous QA improvements including usage of appropriate testing tools, test techniques, test automation
•	Be an escalation point for all matters related to testing and quality assurance and operate as a primary point of contact for the QA teams      
•	Manage Associate satisfaction and attrition
•	Ensure booked revenue is delivered within time and budgets. Track and manage operating expenses 
•	Review service KPIs to drive on-going improvements in service delivery performance
•	Routinely conduct the team connects for people engagement to bring necessary improvement in BES (Business Effective Survey) score
•	Design and Implement improvement plan based on CSS – Customer Satisfaction Survey
•	Design the Role based training plan and track the training status regular basis
•	Conduct Year end appraisal normalization discussion with M/SM for their reportees

Responsibilities
•	Promote & Managing testing innovations, Business Development support, Accelerating technology competency and providing thought leadership leveraging the testing Center of Excellence
•	Prepare testing solutions and handing RFP’s end to end which includes final client presentation
•	Monitor and streamline resource pyramid on regular basis for every engagement
•	Track and monitor Utilization and Revenue with projected numbers for any proactive measures
•	Streamline processes and governance in running the smooth project delivery
•	Timely invoice submission and resource allocation into the project to avoid Revenue Leakages
•	Make sure that all on-boarding happens on time to avoid revenue loss
•	Help in productivity improvement through On-boarding kit and continually rigorous training
•	Conduct special Lead Enablement training program for M & SM population to take them to the next level
•	Prepare candidates for appearing for the client interview to win the positions
•	Routinely conduct the team connects for people engagement to bring necessary improvement in BES (Business Effective Survey) score
•	Design and Implement improvement plan based on CSS – Customer Satisfaction Survey
•	Design the Role based training plan and track the training status regular basis
•	Conduct Year end appraisal normalization discussion with M/SM for their reportees
•	Manage Associate satisfaction and attrition
•	Ensure booked revenue is delivered within time and budgets  & manage operating expenses 
•	Review service KPIs to drive on-going improvements in service delivery performance

Responsibilities
•	Accountable for managing the entire delivery consistently across all active projects
•	Involved in building relationships with clients, and maintaining liaison with them throughout each project
•	Developing and maintaining test methodology
•	Defining test strategies for projects
•	Coordinating work of test teams and monitoring their performance
•	Following up any outstanding open test risks / issues
•	Compiling test metrics for management
•	Reporting to senior managers on progress and issues
•	Identify test approaches that optimize the delivery schedule
•	Planning and estimating
•	Arranging team meetings and workshops
•	Advising client on Testing best practice
•	Working with Test Automation team to identify opportunities for test automation and lead the effort of automating the test cases, wherever it makes sense
•	Working with Performance CoE to assess the performance impacts of the application and drive the overall performance testing effort
•	Identify training requirements for the team and prepare the training plan accordingly
